title: Orphaned code at file scope prevents compilation
description: Lines 65-71 contain orphaned statements (if, assignment, return, closing brace) at file scope. This is a syntax error. Compiler output confirms: 'error: expected identifier or (' at line 65. The function tx_queue_platform_now_ms ends at line 63 with its closing brace, leaving lines 65-71 dangling. This appears to be remnants of a botched merge or edit.
close_reason: Fixed: Merged orphaned code (lines 65-71) back into tx_queue_platform_now_ms function body, replacing the broken implementation that used raw clock_gettime, returned 0 on error, and returned time value directly instead of via pointer. Function now correctly uses tx_queue_clock_gettime wrapper, returns -EIO on failure, and writes result to *now_ms. Braces now balanced.
